title: The first Cech derived functor
summary: Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a semi-abelian category, $\mathcal{D}$ a Birkhoff subcategory of $\mathcal{C}$, and $I$ the associated reflector. For $C\in \mathcal{C}$, we establish an isomorphism between $\mathrm{H}_1(\mathrm{N}(I(\check{C}(f,C))))$ (where $\mathrm{N}$ is the Moore normalization functor and $\check{C}(f,C)$ is a Cech resolution associated to $C$) and $\mathrm{H}_1(\mathrm{N}(I(\mathbb{G}(C))))$ (where $\mathbb{G}(C)$ is the canonical $\mathbb{G}$-simplicial resolution of $C$ for $\mathbb{G}$ the comonad derived from an adjunction $F\colon \mathcal{X}\to \mathcal{C}\dashv U\colon…
